2117127060493578466.en_summary: Steve Hanke on #TurkeyWatch: Istanbul’s official annual retail inflation came in at 32.47%/yr in October. Today, he measures Turkey’s inflation at 22.31%/yr. Since his measure leads the official one, he expects the official number to fall. Inflation is still Erdoğan’s Achilles heel.
2117127060493578466.zh_summary: Steve Hanke關於#TurkeyWatch：伊斯坦布爾官方年度零售通脹10月為32.47%/年。今天，他測量土耳其通脹為22.31%/年。由於他的測量領先官方數字，他預計官方數字將下降。通脹仍是埃爾多安的致命弱點。

2117106764550214038.en_summary: US healthcare costs are rising at an alarming rate: medical care prices have surged +132% since 2000, the largest increase among major consumer spending categories. Shelter costs +127%, food +112%, all outpacing overall CPI +99% since 2000. ~30% of insured US adults have skipped or delayed needed healthcare due to costs over the last 12 months per KFF survey. Healthcare costs have never been higher.
2117106764550214038.zh_summary: 美國醫療保健成本正以驚人速度上升：自2000年以來醫療護理價格飆升+132%，是主要消費者支出類別中最大增幅。住房成本+127%，食品+112%，均超過整體CPI自2000年以來的+99%。根據KFF調查，過去12個月約30%的受保美國成年人因成本跳過或延遲所需醫療保健。醫療保健成本從未如此高。
